name: atoms/symfony
description: Symfony bundle for Atoms (Phase 1 internal skeleton — a layering test, not yet a supported product).

suggest.symfony/messenger: Routes AtomJob callbacks through Messenger (MessengerQueueBridge); without it, NullQueueBridge throws on first use
suggest.symfony/console: Registers the atoms:deploy / atoms:rollback / atoms:list console wrappers
suggest.guzzlehttp/psr7: Default PSR-17 factory, and the (bridge-free) PSR-7 conversion used by CallbackController
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Default PSR-18 client used when no atoms.http_client / ClientInterface service is configured
